_comment: Snake locale file. DO NOT translate keys (left side). Only translate values (right side). Keep every {placeholder} exactly as-is. Do NOT translate the move/direction tokens the player types ([up], [down], [left], [right], w, s, a, d) or the ASCII board rendered into {board}.

_slots.{num_players}: Number of players in the match
_slots.{board}: The rendered ASCII grid; keep neutral, never translate its characters
_slots.{groups}: Neutral ranking data (a list of player-id groups, worst to best); do not translate

player_prompt.intro:
{num_players}-Zuiadôr Serpont su une {width}×{height} grilee.
Tu controllis serpont {player_id}. Moviments valids: '[up]'/'[down]'/'[left]'/'[right]' (o w/s/a/d).
Obietîf: supravivî il plui lung o jessi il plui lung e otignî il puntuazion plui alt (limite di vuelte {max_turns} vuelis).

game_action.invalid_death: Snake {player_id} al è muart par vie di une mosse no valide.

outcome.survived_win: Il zuiadôr {player_id} al è sorevivude; ducj chei altris a son muarts.
outcome.all_dead_simul: Ducj i sarpints a muririn tal stes moment.
outcome.outlived: Il zuiadôr al è rivât a vivi plui di ducj i altris.
outcome.turn_limit: Al è rivât il limit di volte - vincidôr al tie-break.
